description.narrative: IOM will continue the pre-departure medical procedures (PDMP) implemented shortly before a migrant’s departure. The PDMP aims to prepare for safe and dignified travel so it is adjusted for individual health needs that may have been identified during a pre-migration health assessment. It will integrate the provision of additional public health interventions, such as vaccinations, health education and counselling, surveillance for communicable diseases, testing and treatment for parasites, other public health interventions.
